card.name: Words just before donor or donation terms
card.fires_on: Words in blood or organ donation text where the next word is likely donor, donate or donation. This includes step numbers in plasma collection procedures and linking words like from, a, or and giving.

modes.label: Collection procedure steps
modes.description: Numbered steps in blood or plasma collection and apheresis instructions.

modes.label: Linking words before donor
modes.description: Small words in transplant or donation sentences that lead into donor or donate.

modes.label: Giving an organ
modes.description: Verbs about giving a kidney or blood.
modes.example: you may be thinking of<< giving>> one of your kidneys
